description: Currently working on the development of the Namla web application — a platform that manages the deployment of edge computing applications. Architecting and building frontend for enterprise-grade dashboards.
Created and maintained the front-end of Postlyy, a social media management tool that allows users to schedule and publish posts on multiple platforms.
Co-founded PivotPoint BMS, an ERP software for small and medium-sized businesses. Developed the front-end using Next.js, Redux, and Tailwind CSS.
Created a management solution for clinic staff and patients with statistics and activity tracking. Implemented multi-account access with different specialties and privileges.
Participated in pre-project analysis and technical assessments. Built reusable code to minimize costs. Scheduled meetings with clients to discuss website design preferences and requirements.
